claim_scope: Development-only DROID one-step Cartesian command-direction prediction; not a general omni benchmark.

input_contract.timebase: uniform source step indices; no per-step wall-clock timestamps asserted

source_partition: Official Google Research DROID r2d2_faceblur 1.0.0 train shards 00000..00019 only.
target_definition: Dominant signed xyz axis of commanded Cartesian velocity at the step immediately after the last observed state; stop when max abs(xyz) <= 1e-4.
